svg.aria-label: Change the model, not the effort. The Claude model and effort behind each of bkit's 39 agents and 5 orchestrators. Opus 5.5 at Medium: /bkit-design, /bkit-plan, /bkit-debug, 7 agents; Opus 5.5 at High: 20 agents; Sonnet 5.5 at Medium: /bkit-build, /bkit-ship, 10 agents; Sonnet 5.5 at High: 2 agents. Fable 5.1 is never pinned: use it by hand to refine an idea before /bkit-design, and at Extra for a bug /bkit-debug is stuck on. Pick the model at launch: claude-opus-5-5 for /bkit-design, /bkit-plan, /bkit-debug; claude-sonnet-5-5 for /bkit-build, /bkit-ship. Leave the effort alone: medium is the default on the 5.5 models, every agent sets its own, and never set CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL. Past High, move up a model: Extra costs more than the next model up at High. Max is for one hard problem, never routine; ultracode is a setting, not a level.
